title: Lānaʻi City parking code change
summary: The Lānaʻi Planning Commission voted unanimously to start a parking code change for part of Lānaʻi City after a public hearing with one supporting testifier. A formal amendment was tentatively set to return December 18, and the planner said he would take it to the Council if advanced.

timeline.text: Commissioners voted unanimously by a show of hands to start the code change.
The planner said that if the commission moves the amendment forward, he will take it to the council.
The planner said a formal amendment is tentatively set to return on December 18th.
A county planner said this vote would only start the code change process.
One testifier spoke in strong support of the change.
The commission held a public hearing on starting a parking code change for part of Lānaʻi City.
